title: Bubbling Gnocchi Broccoli Cheese
description: Gnocchi and haricot beans simmered in a creamy milk and cream cheese sauce with broccoli, topped with Cheddar and baked until bubbling.
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of haricot beans, drained and rinsed
florets from a head of broccoli, broken into bite-sized pieces
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
Pour the milk into a deep flameproof casserole dish and bring to a simmer.
Add the gnocchi and haricot beans and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the cream cheese and simmer for a further 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

Add the stock, onion granules, garlic granules, broccoli and about half the Cheddar. Stir, season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, then remove from heat and sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.
Pop the pot into the oven, near the top, and bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese on top is browning and bubbling.
notes: Add a can of drained tuna in spring water with the broccoli for a cheesy tuna bake. Add 1 teaspoon chilli flakes to spice it up. Try adding cauliflower florets for a cauliflower cheese vibe.
